_comment: Index template for `datalake-events`: the analytical copy of the sensor
events that demo-producer also writes to Cassandra (CDC §7.8).
Cassandra answers 'the last N minutes for THIS sensor' — its partition key
is built for that. Elasticsearch answers everything else: averages across
sites, comparisons between sensors, arbitrary time ranges. The two are
complementary by design (ADR-0007), not a duplication.

_meta.dynamic: strict here, unlike the logs: this stream has ONE producer with a fixed schema. A document carrying an unexpected field is a bug in demo-producer and must be rejected loudly rather than silently stored.
_meta.float: float and not double: sensor precision is ~0.1 degree, so 7 significant digits are ample and the index is half the size.
_meta.refresh_interval: 5s: the Datalake dashboard shows a near-live rate, so a 10s delay would be visible; 1s would be wasteful.
